svg: Masked Self-Attention vs Causal AttentionBERT sees everything, GPT only sees the pastBERT: Bidirectional (Masked)Sentence: "The cat sat on the mat"Task: Predict [MASK] in "The [MASK] sat on the mat"Attention Matrix (all 1s = can attend) The [MASK] sat on the matThe: 1 1 1 1 1 1[MASK]: 1 1 1 1 1 1 ← Sees ALL!sat: 1 1 1 1 1 1on: 1 1 1 1 1 1the: 1 1 1 1 1 1mat: 1 1 1 1 1 1✓ Can use BOTH left and right context[MASK] sees: "The", "sat", "on", "the", "mat" → predicts "cat"GPT: Causal (Unidirectional)<text x="770" y="190" style="font: 12px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;">Sentence: "The cat sat on the mat"Task: Predict next word given previous words<text x="1050" y="280" style="font: 12px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;" text-anchor="middle">Attention Matrix (triangular = causal) The cat sat on the matThe: 1 0 0 0 0 0cat: 1 1 0 0 0 0sat: 1 1 1 0 0 0 ← Only left!on: 1 1 1 1 0 0the: 1 1 1 1 1 0mat: 1 1 1 1 1 1✓ Can ONLY use left (previous) context"sat" sees: "The", "cat" → predicts "on" (no cheating!)BERT: Why Bidirectional?Use Case: Understanding ContextSentence: "I went to the bank by the river"Q: Financial bank or river bank?A: Need to see "river" (right context) → river bank!Perfect for:• Classification, Q&A, NER (need full context)GPT: Why Causal?<text x="770" y="605" style="font: 11px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;">Use Case: Text GenerationInput: "Once upon a time, there was a"→ Predict: "princess" (can't see future!)→ Next: "Once upon a time, there was a princess who"→ Predict: "lived" ...<text x="770" y="715" style="font: 10px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;">Perfect for:• Generation, completion (must be autoregressive)KEY DIFFERENCES SUMMARYBERT (Encoder):✓ Sees entire sentence (bidirectional)✓ Great for understanding tasks✓ Pre-training: Masked language modeling✓ Use: Classification, embeddings, Q&A<text x="710" y="855" style="font: 12px sans-serif; font-weight="bold;">GPT (Decoder):✓ Sees only previous words (causal)✓ Great for generation tasks✓ Pre-training: Next token prediction✓ Use: Text generation, chatbots, completionThe choice between BERT and GPT depends on your task: understanding vs generation!
